summary.headline: Theophilus and the Paris Excerpts
summary.text: Discussion of Theophilus of Edessa, astrologer to Caliph Al-Mahdi, his star-longitude revisions, and the transmission of the anonymous astrologer of 379 through Palchus, Arabic astrologers, and the Paris Excerpts. The passage reassesses the possible identification with Julian of Laodicea and notes the use of a Roman copy for the first chapter of the Angelicus manuscript’s Apotelesmata.
